name: chat-coss
title: Chat
description: A dark group chat panel: an avatar stack header, a date pill and unread divider, incoming and outgoing bubbles with emoji reaction chips, quoted reply references, delivery ticks and a typing line above the composer.
use: You need a group conversation with replies, reactions and read state assembled from separate parts.
avoid: A single support chatbot bubble: this is a full multi-person thread with composer, far heavier than needed.
a11y: The log is labelled and live, controls have aria labels and reduced motion is honoured; reactions remain pointer first. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A tall dark panel with a header of overlapping avatars and the group name. Inside, short rounded grey bubbles sit left with tiny avatars and names, and right in a slightly lighter fill, with emoji chips underneath and a quoted block above one message. A rounded composer with a circular send button closes the bottom.
behaves: Sending appends a right-aligned bubble whose small clock turns into a tick, and the thread scrolls to it. A New divider marks unseen messages, a Priya is typing line with dots sits before the composer, and reaction chips toggle on click.
customise: Parts take content through props and children: bubble side and grouping, reaction chips, delivery status, replies and typing labels; layout and theme come from classes.
weight: moderate: Several spring animations for bubbles and reactions plus a scrolling log; no continuous loop.
demo: Launch crew thread with Priya, Daniel and Sofia discussing release notes for 4.2 and a post going live.
issues: Reaction counts and timestamps are very small and low contrast on the dark bubbles.
polishWhy: Polished group chat with believable details; tiny metadata text is the only weak point.
